title: payment-instruction LinkedRecord payload
description: What should be paid, keyed to a Unit by event_id only — never inside the credential (§8). Released on every T=7 exit, including dispute: a dispute contests the record, it does not withhold the money (W4).

releasedBy.description: Which of the four exits released it. All four are here on purpose — an instruction with no 'dispute' case is a system that quietly withholds pay.

heldReason.description: Every held payment has a reason with an owner (W10). Absent unless state is HELD.
